description: Execute JavaScript on a one-off page: loads `url` in a fresh browser context, optionally waits `wait_secs` for the page to settle, evaluates `script` (async/Promise supported) and returns `{url, result}`. Script-driven navigation (location.href, form submit) is drained and reflected in the returned `url`. Stateless — no cookies or page state shared with other calls; when the script needs prior page state or a login, use session_eval.
name: eval
